scope: Post-hoc mechanism sensitivity; not new independent validation
reporting_note: Report tables and plotting labels were finalized after the run; original optimization manifest hashes are preserved.

tests.command: python -B -m pytest tests/test_forecast.py tests/test_dispatch.py tests/test_evaluation.py tests/test_study.py -p no:cacheprovider -o addopts= -q

run_command: python -B -X utf8 -m ecogrid --config configs/mechanisms.json --source measured --output results/mechanisms
report_command: python -B -X utf8 -c "from pathlib import Path; from ecogrid.diagnostics import write_mechanism_figures; write_mechanism_figures(Path('results/mechanisms'))"
